name: tonggao-tex
description: 多人实时协作 LaTeX 与 AI 写作工作台

scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n server,client,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @tonggao/server dev" "pnpm --filter @tonggao/client dev" "pnpm --filter @tonggao/desktop dev"
scripts.build:win: pnpm --filter @tonggao/client build && pnpm --filter @tonggao/server bundle && pnpm --filter @tonggao/desktop package:win
